summary_en: Shimizu Corporation executed a block purchase of 4,254,400 shares (0.63% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a total of 9,999,967,200 yen via ToSTNeT-3 on September 25, 2026, at the closing price of 2,350.5 yen on September 24, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding Acquisition of Own Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 24, 2026, Shimizu Corporation's Board of Directors authorized a block purchase of its own shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company executed this purchase on September 25, 2026, through an off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3) conducted at the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The company acquired 4,254,400 shares at a total cost of 9,999,967,200 yen, equivalent to 0.63% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock as of June 30, 2026). The purchase price was set at 2,350.5 yen per share, which was the closing price on September 24, 2026. The transaction was conducted as a single order during the specified trading time on September 25 at 8:45 a.m.

This block purchase was part of a larger share buyback authorization approved by the Board, which set a maximum acquisition limit of 12 million shares (1.77% of issued shares) or 20 billion yen over the period from August 17 to December 30, 2026, using market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 transactions.
